мусити.text:
Inherited from Old Ruthenian му́сити (músiti), from Old Polish musić, from Middle High German müeȥen, from Old High German muoȥan, from Proto-West Germanic *mōtan, from Proto-Germanic *mōtaną (whence German müssen and English must). Compare loans from the same source Belarusian му́сіць (músicʹ), Czech muset, Slovak musieť, Polish musieć.
The derived terms include the imperfective verb змушувати and its perfective counterpart змусити (to force, to compel, to obligate).
